description: Direct strict-schema interpreter cases run by every language runner. expect is the sorted violation list (instance pointer:keyword), or 'malformed' for JSON text every reader must refuse to parse. 'unsupported' schemas must fail closed at load time. Declared by hand; verify.py also checks them against jsonschema Draft202012Validator.

cases.name: frame_output_sequence_float_integer
cases.note: 1.0 is an integer (zero fraction) in JSON Schema 2020-12

cases.name: frame_output_sequence_bool
cases.note: booleans are never numbers

cases.name: frame_output_sequence_huge
cases.note: beyond 2^53: every parser still exceeds the bound

cases.name: frame_time_base_float_equal
cases.note: const uses numeric equality

cases.name: frame_time_base_bool
cases.note: true != 1

cases.name: frame_missing_state
cases.note: if/then is vacuous without state; only the root required fails

cases.name: frame_astral_reason_length
cases.note: length counts code points (65), not UTF-16 units (130)

cases.name: frame_uuid_trailing_newline
cases.note: $ never matches before a trailing newline

cases.name: clocks_map_bad_value_and_name
cases.note: propertyNames errors are reported at the map; value errors at the key

cases.name: clocks_map_key_pointer_escaping
cases.note: pointer tokens percent-encode UTF-8 bytes outside [A-Za-z0-9._-]

cases.name: invalid_utf8
cases.note: the runner substitutes bytes 0xff 0xfe

cases.name: bom_prefix
cases.note: UTF-8 BOM (EF BB BF) before an otherwise valid event; never stripped

cases.name: nesting_root_arrays_at_limit
cases.note: 32 open containers: the maximum nesting depth

cases.name: nesting_root_arrays_over_limit
cases.note: 33 open containers exceed the nesting limit of 32

cases.name: nesting_unknown_value_at_limit
cases.note: root object + 31 nested arrays = 32 open containers

cases.name: nesting_unknown_value_over_limit
cases.note: root object + 32 nested arrays = 33 open containers

cases.name: nesting_unknown_objects_over_limit
cases.note: root object + 32 nested objects = 33 open containers

cases.name: nesting_far_over_limit
cases.note: 20000 nested arrays: rejected by the depth bound before any runtime stack limit

cases.name: nesting_brackets_inside_string
cases.note: brackets inside a string are not nesting

cases.name: lone_high_surrogate_value
cases.note: unpaired high surrogate escape (RFC 7493)

cases.name: lone_low_surrogate_map_key
cases.note: unpaired low surrogate escape as a map key

cases.name: reversed_surrogate_pair
cases.note: low then high surrogate is not a pair

cases.name: high_surrogate_then_bmp_escape
cases.note: high surrogate followed by a non-surrogate escape

cases.name: lone_surrogate_vs_replacement_keys
cases.note: an unpaired surrogate is never turned into U+FFFD (which would also make the keys look duplicate)

cases.name: replacement_char_map_key
cases.note: a real U+FFFD key is valid JSON; pointer tokens percent-encode its UTF-8 bytes

cases.name: surrogate_pair_map_key
cases.note: a valid escaped surrogate pair is one astral scalar

cases.name: composed_decomposed_map_keys
cases.note: canonically equivalent but distinct code point sequences are distinct keys, never duplicates

cases.name: composed_decomposed_root_keys
cases.note: distinct keys U+00E9 and e+U+0301 are not duplicates

cases.name: escaped_literal_duplicate_key
cases.note: escaped and literal spellings of the same code points are a duplicate key

cases.name: escaped_decomposed_duplicate_key
cases.note: the same decomposed sequence written escaped and literally is a duplicate key
